campaign: Integrated validation, phase 2: bounded capability gains and evidence-gated simplification
doctrine:
Priority: prevent duplicate worker dispatch and silent stop resumption, then remove manual step-editing friction; keep independent retained-cost measurements available. Determine and reduce unnecessary testing before starting another model bundle. Finish the existing provenance repair, land safe census reuse and cheaper publication, then deliver one measured reduction in an expensive real gate batch. Allow publication-command automation after its measurement independently of gate-wall repairs; make local API/binary consolidation part of touched-owner improvements without blocking the first speed result. Freeze the target and regression comparison before implementation; do not make broad analysis or another infrastructure campaign a prerequisite. Completed model evidence remains accepted within its recorded scope. Preserve accepted functionality when execution dependencies, weights, recipes and fixtures remain valid; reacquire only invalidated evidence or demonstrated defects. E4B modality quality, protocol and resource acceptance stands. Its throughput obligation remains separate: preserve failed measurements, require a quantitative code-cost hypothesis and discriminating measurement, and retain performance-catalog requirements. Measurement-only changes do not invalidate functionality; never repeat probes merely to obtain a pass. Raw instruction-model NLL alone is not a defect; use chat-shaped evaluation and matched-checkpoint references.

Scope and authority: preserve the capability freeze enforced by structure. No new model family, workflow, optimizer or general orchestration framework. Work covers reproduced defects, missing acceptance, regression protection and evidence-backed simplification in existing owners. docs/plan.json is the sole live plan; depends_on controls prerequisites and document order ranks ready work. Preserve row identities, historical completion references, lower-bound verifies, outstanding obligations and operator stops. One writer owns each edit and publishes it with its coherent implementation/evidence batch. Executable dispatch atomically claims a row for a distinct worker/session and supported worktree scope; role unassigned is not shared identity. Plan edits compare expected document/step/claim identity and preserve active foreign work unless an explicit handoff or scoped operator override authorizes the change. Keep rows focused on deliverables and acceptance; stable policy belongs in its owner and historical results in OvergoDB/Git.

Fix as you go: reproduce and preserve the failure, correct its cause, then run affected checks. A finding, UNAVAILABLE, skip or missing fixture does not complete work. Find, acquire or construct supported fixtures with provenance and frozen oracles. Never credit absent, incomplete or zero-matching tests. Correctness, security, data-loss and invalid-measurement defects interrupt affected claims; independent authorized work continues. Do not normalize failures into baselines or auto-repair thresholds, model floors or evidence authorities.

Touched-file discipline: inspect changed files for unexplained literals and duplicated policy. Derive dimensions, limits, tolerances, resource choices and boundaries from artifact declarations, typed contracts, mathematical constraints or measured inputs; reuse their existing owner. A named constant or configuration field alone does not justify an arbitrary value. Keep exact format/ABI values, mathematical identities and justified policy literals at their owning contract with source, scope and validation. Tests may retain explicit independent input/expected pairs and boundary fixtures; give cases and quantities clear meaning, share repeated fixture setup, and never derive the expected result from the implementation under test. Correct local misuse in the same coherent change without an unrelated repository-wide sweep. Record unresolved semantic assumptions through the existing decision authority with a reason and revisit trigger; do not disguise them as cleanup.

Consolidate ownership while touching code: admission, model lookup, resolved inputs, execution, receipt validity and publication each need one authority. Migrate callers and remove displaced wrappers, exports and duplicate retry, timeout, release or publication paths in the same batch. Preserve protocol, flag, exit and evidence contracts and the 9964 duplicate-excess ceiling. The second manual repetition triggers an owner review, not automatic command creation; align skill.md through the existing consolidation row. Add a daemon, scheduler, executable or public API only for demonstrated missing capability with net ownership reduction. Record preserved behavior, exported surface and maintenance cost; file splitting and forwarding facades alone prove no improvement. Prioritize real API and executable removal with atomic caller/build/release migration. Track exports, wrappers, command packages and shipped binaries separately; preserve required compatibility and isolation, reject dependency fan-out without measured benefit, and give temporary aliases explicit retirement obligations.

Model workflow: derive every supported mode from artifacts, projectors, recipes, compatibility claims and fixtures. Prepare datasets and native references on CPU; run owning-package CPU contracts, one fixed end-to-end diagnostic, required GPU parity, then the full quality/protocol/resource denominator. Freeze held-out selection, oracles and criteria before acquisition. Group compatible cases per residency, retain required warmups/repeats/isolation, and persist each completed cell immediately. Activation, infrastructure and diagnostics grant no model acceptance. Unsupported modes require artifact-bound exclusions; missing supported modes remain repairs. Retain E4B acceptance and measure the same complete workflow on subsequent models.

Acceptance and publication: preserve parity, longform and report checks as lower bounds. Before dispatch use plan -setverify to bind missing assertions to their owning packages; new tests require their files. Name the exact model/task/case denominator, protocols, identities, thresholds and exclusions. Listings, freshness and builds alone do not prove capability. Freeze and commit runnable producer/repair batches before clean-source publication; gates consume retained long-campaign evidence without reacquisition. Use canonical OVERGO_DATA_ROOT. Each evaluate pass has an explicit measured -budget. Preserve all 12032 MMLU-Pro cases and both protocols; MATH stays excluded. The full 27B pass remains operator-launched with -budget 3h and does not wait for unrelated simplification.

Regression protection: publish the immutable accepted guard before broad execution changes, retain baseline-repair prerequisites, and expand/re-accept full-catalog protection after modality validation. Broad numerical/API simplification follows the initial modality report, small-model benchmark and row-specific regression prerequisites. Preserve corpus-at-commit, floors, baseline IDs, surface identity and bounded cancellation. Compare quality, throughput, peak/retained memory and recovery on identical inputs; aggregate gains cannot hide a required regression. Verify relocation and rollback before retiring originals.

Gate composition: extend existing recipe, dependency, plan, execution and receipt owners. Compile a deterministic verification DAG from cumulative changes; bind check definitions, resolved inputs, environment, resources and acceptance before execution. Use binding-aware AST/type and dependency analysis to explain changed file/symbol -> dependency or reachable read -> selected check -> invalidator or reusable result. Syntax matches and annotations are not isolation proofs; unresolved calls and control-flow joins retain conservative scope. Selection and receipt identity share resolved inputs. Observed read logs require explicit instrumentation coverage and bounded unobserved effects; absent observations are not independence proofs. Run cheap refusals before expensive work and persist independent terminal passes immediately. Preserve producer provenance and exact unchanged node results across successor recipes and restart; a plan identity change alone does not establish an input change. Cache immutable computations with complete source, analyzer/build, baseline/policy and environment identities; plan-dependent results include edited-plan/step/role identity. Recheck current admission, expiry, scope, branch/index and store authority before publication. No competing scheduler or model-generated exemption.

Gate repair and adoption: freeze a bounded change contract, independent acceptance matrix, baseline selector, affected owners and integration boundary before implementation. Iterate with cheap static and affected-owner checks; expected development failures remain recorded and trigger causal repair, not automatic replay of the whole campaign. Distinguish a real regression, a deliberately replaced policy assertion, missing evidence and an unrelated failure. A policy assertion may change only with the declared behavior and retained independent regression proof; failures and unknowns never become passes. Keep recoverable checkpoints separate from verified/promoted completion, with durable obligations through existing plan, gate and evidence owners. Run the pre-existing broad integration scope once for the completed transition batch; on retry reuse exact independent passes and reopen only checks whose inputs or contracts changed. Gate-policy, kernel, concurrency, persistence, authentication and public-contract edits immediately run their affected critical checks; that escalation does not require every unrelated suite on each edit. Promote reduced selection only after seeded relevant failures are detected, unrelated changes avoid the chosen expensive work, receipts remain valid and total cost improves. The candidate cannot approve its own weaker acceptance. Full short-profile receipts retain their separate scope; excluded, skipped, unavailable or unfinished assertions earn no complete-mode credit.

Documentation boundary: ordinary README.md, skill.md and top-level docs Markdown receive document acceptance without package, model, device or browser suites. Embedded or explicitly named runtime Markdown remains a software input; nested fixtures/evidence, assets and mixed source changes retain required runtime scope. The live plan retains admission, bound acceptance and atomic advancement. Unknown runtime I/O still broadens software changes. Selection and receipt inputs use the same classification; exclusions grant no fresh runtime evidence. Measure planning through commit: zero runtime suites is not zero total wall time.

Supervision and concurrency: operator stops persist until explicit scoped resumption; a commit never implies resume. Interactive and unattended consumers share one typed stop authority with explicit execution mode. Read-only diagnostics remain available. Supervise every gate to terminal success or explicit bounded failure, preserving attempts and obligations across restart. Normal contention queues on the existing OS lock until release or caller cancellation; report waiting separately from failure. Respect declared overall operation budgets without resetting retries; no arbitrary contention timer, lock stealing or polling wrapper. Database ownership covers a refreshed write transaction, never server lifetime. Prove concurrent commits, crash recovery and idle/serving workbench coexistence through transaction-writer and workbench-writer-lifetime. Recover abandoned gate state through its authority under exclusive admission. Reconcile exact recording debt; changed source, conflicting branch/index, foreign ownership and corrupt evidence refuse destructive recovery.

Resource lifetime: close the exact owned handle on normal/error exit; cancellation drains acquisition and process death releases ownership. Verify queued-waiter recovery, release/cancellation races, repeated release and reacquisition. Never unlink or replace owned lock files or infer abandonment from heartbeat age or process names. CPU-only work holds no GPU lease; correctness shares fitting capacity. Isolated measurements acquire exclusion only for their consumer lifetime, never beneath an ancestor shared lease. Report actual release and the released resource, not global idleness. Notify exhausted/nonrecoverable failures with the exact next action.

Incremental improvement: coalesce completed-run, failure and recurring-cost observations through existing loop, run-record, candidate and plan owners. Retrieve objectives, measurements, prior attempts, owners and remaining budget. Admit bounded hypotheses, preserve candidate dispositions, observation position, exact results, outstanding checks and cumulative cost, and resume unfinished transitions without duplicate proposals or acquisitions. Rejection, a named resumption trigger and no useful action are valid decisions. Proposal policy may evolve; each experiment keeps frozen independent acceptance and operator ceilings. No controller rewrite is a prerequisite to model progress.

Compounding priority: Execution order: publication-cost measurement, selection-cause histogram and suite-cost ranking stay on the first frontier using retained records, alongside in-progress provenance repair. Publication-command automation depends only on its measurement and can remove manual cost independently. Safe census reuse and checkpoint-control repair precede the bounded reduction implementation where their dependencies require it; one implementation batch feeds one retained-evidence adoption review. Focused API/binary removal precedes broader analysis when it offers the smaller supported improvement. Dependencies encode real prerequisites, not preferences between independent work. Prefer a structural removal that produces both speed and smaller ownership when its contracts are known. Reuse a consolidation already delivered inside an earlier batch. Command usability fixes are independent bounded existing-owner work: authoritative help/metadata, early readiness, visible frontier/stop diagnostics, concise dispatch contracts and a supported scratch invocation. Do not serialize them behind unrelated gate-policy repairs or make them a campaign prerequisite to publication or model validation. No new model acquisition is needed for these automation acceptances; return to the next model bundle after the first expensive-work reduction, without waiting for publication-command automation, the full consolidation campaign or complete analysis stack. Record recurring cost, consumers, expected remaining repetitions, implementation/verification/maintenance cost, benefit, confidence and rollback before dispatch. Rank ready improvements by expected net wall, compute, acquisitions and interventions saved; report these separately unless weights are declared. Compare each change with the latest accepted stack and periodically compare the stack with its original baseline on identical workloads. Do not double-count overlapping savings or multiply isolated speed ratios. Uncertain reuse belongs within exploration ceilings. Preserve failed approaches; require new evidence before expanding a hypothesis. For the current priority, finish one end-to-end testing reduction before returning to the next missing model bundle. Preparatory repairs, reports and synthetic cache hits do not satisfy that milestone. Expand analysis only for a named unresolved boundary preventing the frozen target; otherwise stop the experiment with its evidence and choose the smaller supported change.

Cost and rollout: judge complete attempts by accepted task/model improvement, recovery success, operator interventions and repeated work, including proposal, loading, failure, waiting, verification and finalization. Retain uninstrumented time as unattributed; do not invent cost allocation or treat phase sums as an elapsed-time partition. Separate wall from summed parallel durations; distinguish executed, reused, failed and unstarted checks, invalidations, reloads and outstanding obligations. Use identical-input cold/restart comparisons before rollout. Inconclusive optimizations remain in shadow or are removed. After model validation compare one bounded existing RSI policy with a fixed baseline and ablation on held-out tasks under equal total budgets and an independent retained judge. Explicit no-promotion may close an experiment, never claim improvement.

Storage and records: keep operational state in existing typed JSON/OvergoDB contracts; never automate ad hoc Markdown plans, handoffs, status or results. Keep human documentation concise and render reports from structured authority. Preserve consumers, release contracts, identities and provenance before retiring documents. Reuse equivalent analyses, results and immutable content before layout changes. Evaluate bounded append-only packs for small records with a rebuildable hash/offset index; keep large payloads separate. Copy only new immutable segments and captured active extents. Derive sizes from measured publication, lookup, backup and recovery cost; retain per-record checksums, crash safety, concurrent readers and serialized writes. Restart never requires duplicate snapshots or completed acquisitions.

Lane boundaries: master owns validation, numerics and integration; GUI owns HTTP/browser/transport and its open plan; audio retains its independent plan and development. Consume committed, proven work through existing intake authorities without replaying merges or importing open lane plans. validation-gate-selection coordinates Hatchet analysis intake; inspect current owners/results and assign one writer before overlapping work. Preserve integrated GUI capability projection, media lineage, dispatch, remote-provider and conversation-recovery contracts in docs/gui/INTEGRATION.md, plus CPU audio production/segmentation and open native streaming admission. Infrastructure does not prove local model quality. Preserve master's E4B/data-root authority; remote, mock and hosted evidence stays separate from local numerical/quality coverage. Paid-provider evaluation requires explicit authorization. Clean-source browser acceptance and changed-source refusal remain distinct. GUI feature work and a complete optimization stack are never prerequisites to independent model validation.

items.title: Make command discovery, dispatch and publication clear and fast

steps.title: Atomically claim work before issuing an executable dispatch
steps.verify: test -f internal/plan/dispatch_claim_test.go && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestAtomicDispatchClaim$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/dispatch_claim_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestDispatchClaimProjection$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Highest-consequence repair: two workers in one checkout both used role unassigned, received the same step, and replanning changed a row with another worker's dirty implementation. Extend existing dispatch, WorkLease, role assignment, OvergoDB transaction and workspace ownership; no second scheduler, lock daemon or manual lease file prerequisite. Bind a stable worker/session identity distinct from role and worktree, exact row/contract revision, worktree, declared write claims and owner-approved role. Unassigned is not a shared worker identity or permission to overwrite a lease. Executable dispatch selects and records its claim atomically against refreshed ready frontier and ownership before returning the task; retries by the same worker resume the exact claim without duplication. Keep read-only inspection explicit: next/frontier display claimant, scope and status; inspection alone must not silently acquire ownership.

A competing worker gets another eligible task only in a checkout/write scope supported by current gate isolation. Do not equate different rows with safe concurrent implementation in the same mutable worktree; prefer an isolated registered worktree, or return a specific waiting/read-only obligation when none is safe. Claims protect active contract/dependency edits as well as source paths. Plan editing uses compare-and-set on expected document/step/claim identity; changing another worker's active contract requires an explicit handoff or scoped operator override with durable invalidation. Never silently replan beneath dirty work.

Completion, cancellation and explicit handoff release the exact claim; preserve durable results and outstanding checks. Process termination can release process-owned handles, but an advisory timestamp or process name is not proof that remote/session ownership ended. Model stale/unknown claims as visible recovery obligations through existing lifecycle and reviewed retirement; do not steal live ownership or create endless stale blockers. Acceptance forces simultaneous workers, both unassigned, same/different worktrees, overlapping claims, source and plan mutations, restart, retry, cancellation, completion and owner loss. Exactly one winner owns a row; unrelated safe work proceeds and original dirty edits survive. Test real transaction/dispatch handoff and final admission, not just frontier formatting.

steps.title: Honor explicit operator stops until scoped resumption across every consumer
steps.verify: test -f internal/plan/stop_state_test.go && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestStopStateContract$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/stop_status_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestStopStatusProjection$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Second consequence priority. A stop remains active until the operator explicitly lifts it within its recorded scope; HEAD changes by any worker are provenance, not a resumption trigger. Distinguish supervised interactive sessions from unattended cmd/loop operation through explicit execution mode and stop scope. Hooks read the shared stop result before demanding continuation. Normal status remains readable; an explicitly authorized maintenance or stop-publication action is distinct from resuming unattended work. The hook currently matches the stop HEAD, loop pauses on file existence, and gate has no shared interpretation. Consolidate parsing and scope/lifetime interpretation in the existing plan owner; migrate next, prompt/context, loop, loophook and gate consumers in one bounded contract change. Report active, explicitly resumed, legacy lapsed or invalid state, reason, owner/scope, bound HEAD and observed current HEAD. For legacy HEAD-bound records, report the historical mismatch and old lapse behavior without treating it as fresh permission to resume. Migrate a recorded operator user-stop to explicit-resume semantics under the declared owner; never invent the historical lapse commit. File existence alone and silent HEAD mismatch must not remain competing authorities. Freeze lifetime and migration rules before editing: a durable operator user-stop is not implicitly resumed by another worktree commit; resumption is explicit and scoped. Distinguish a stop of autonomous dispatch from permission for an explicitly requested maintenance/publication action, so the user can repair or record a stop without a global deadlock. Gate and dispatch recheck applicable current stop authority; read-only status stays available. Preserve legacy records and test foreign commit, explicit resume, malformed marker, owner/scope mismatch and contradictory legacy consumers. No daemon, new lock or automatic deletion. This row owns stop policy; dispatch-readiness only projects its result.

Acceptance must exercise each consumer: plan next/prompt, interactive Stop hook, unattended loop and gate admission. Cover an operator stop followed by another worker's commit, explicit scoped resume, an authorized maintenance commit that does not resume unattended work, and restart. One typed decision owner replaces duplicated HEAD/string/file-existence tests.

steps.title: Apply typed step edits with validation and conflict detection
steps.verify: test -f internal/plan/step_edit_test.go && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestAtomicStepEdit$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/step_edit_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestPlanEditCommand$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Third consequence priority, after dispatch ownership and stop behavior: extend cmd/plan with an explicit plan -edit operation consuming a typed step/edit document from a file. Use existing Step decoding, Validate and canonical Save; support adding/updating a step in an existing item, title, rationale/contract, dependencies, verify and batch fields. No user-written Go transformer, auto-generated Markdown or alternate plan store. Require expected document/step identity and distinguish create from replace; preserve unrelated items, ordering and unknown concurrent changes by refusing a stale edit. Use existing mutation ownership and active-claim validation; this row remains independently implementable with current compare-and-set and consumes dispatch-claim ownership as it lands.

Validate duplicate IDs, dependency cycles/missing authorities, exact owning-package verifies, batch semantics and protected acceptance/completion changes before writing. Do not run arbitrary verify commands merely to edit the document, mark work done or prune a row. A deliberate acceptance change is visible for gate review, not silently normalized. Acceptance covers adding a second step, dependency/rationale updates, invalid schema, stale document, active foreign claim, interrupted Save and failed validation leaving original bytes intact. Emit a concise diff/typed result and exact next publication command from the same CLI declaration.

steps.title: Measure publication cost and identify reusable computations
steps.rationale:
First ready work: extract a bounded target from retained records, alongside the already-started provenance repair. Stop measuring once the safest high-cost repeated computation and its inputs are identified; do not require complete attribution before saving known cost. Use retained records from 6ca71474, 5564cad1 and 7367a3f8; do not repeat broad gates to recreate the baseline. Distinguish process wall, gate-reported wall, admission, compilation, preparation, execution, waiting and finalization. Preserve each recorded interval and its clock/boundary. Parallel phase durations are overlapping work, not additive wall; reconcile their interval union with the observed outer interval and retain uninstrumented residuals as unattributed. Do not assign a remainder to compilation, candidate preparation or manifest planning without observations. Extend existing run-record and cost-attribution owners only where a missing boundary prevents the decision; add no parallel timer or reporting framework.

Classify computations by actual consumed inputs, not phase names. Plan resolution reads the edited document; source census also consumes analyzer, build selection, baseline and policy. The store can advance during publication or concurrent work. Record complete relevant identities and current-state checks separately from reusable immutable computations. Candidate-tree identity changes with a plan edit; reuse unchanged content contributions without assuming the old candidate or its index is valid.

Acceptance: TestPlanPublicationCostBreakdown binds recorded costs and unknowns to retained run identities, preserves selected/executed/reused/failed/unstarted denominators, rejects double-counted overlap and invented attribution, and rejects a computation called plan-independent when it reads the changed plan. A ranked package uses actual execution evidence, never its parent phase duration. Publish the smallest actionable target with a measured baseline and total-cost budget; imperfect historical instrumentation must not create another census campaign.

Use retained-gate-report when available instead of shell-log folklore. Treat the reported Defender quarantine/rebuild loop as a specific hypothesis: record actual compiler/cache execution and available quarantine evidence separately from scanning or cold-cache cost. go run alone does not prove recompilation on every invocation. Prefer an existing supported source/toolchain-bound build artifact if it measurably saves launch cost; retain source identity and stale-binary rejection. Do not disable protection, introduce broad exclusions or automatically restore quarantined code as a performance fix. A supported packaging/signing or operator-resolution requirement stays explicit.

steps.title: Query retained gate phases and outcomes by commit
steps.rationale:
Extend the existing plan -history view with phase detail and exact commit/run selection through runrecord/OvergoDB readers. Choose this existing surface rather than adding another reporting executable or duplicating a gate report. Return both typed JSON and concise human output: record identity, commit, attempts, actual phase durations/outcomes, executed/reused/failed/unstarted checks, waiting, recorded outer wall and unattributed time. Multiple retries for a commit stay distinct; no match, unavailable timing and incomplete finalization are explicit, not zero or fabricated totals. Derive results from retained records, never redirected stderr or a new acquisition.

Acceptance binds reports to recorded succeeded, failed, interrupted and retried attempts, checks exact commit selection and overlap accounting, and proves read-only operation with no gate/model execution. Expose flags and invocation in help. measure can consume this view once available but stays on the first frontier using existing records; report implementation is not a gate-policy prerequisite.

steps.title: Publish a plan edit through the gate with one command
steps.rationale:
Independently of gate-wall optimization, remove repeated manual authoring through the existing cmd/plan and gate composition owners. First inventory current plan-edit, publication, scope and completion helpers. Extend one existing operation and remove displaced orchestration; do not copy gate policy into a convenience wrapper or spawn a new executable. The operation derives the publication row and structure verifier, consumes operator message text, delegates canonical scope admission and publication to the gate, and lets the gate own atomic plan advancement. Cheap preliminary diagnosis is advisory; recheck live authority at admission.

Acceptance: TestPlanPublishCommand verifies exact plan/message/path binding, current scope refusal, successful advancement and restart without duplicate publication. Failure preserves the operator edit and unrelated work; keep failed evidence and owned recovery obligations rather than pretending all durable state is unchanged. Cleanup or rollback may touch only operation-owned artifacts after concurrent-change checks. Measure operator edit-to-commit cost and record removed helper/API paths. Preserve required admission, docs and acceptance contracts. Dispatch after the retained-cost measurement only; no prerequisite on memoization, checkpoint repair, measured adoption or consolidation. It is independently useful for reducing operator work and failed publication attempts, and is not a prerequisite to model progress or the expensive-test reduction.

Share cheap scope/readiness results with dispatch-readiness instead of maintaining a second implementation. Detect the exact plan-only dirty-source refusal before costly admission, using the canonical owner. Never prescribe stash or moving unrelated work as an automatic publication step. Keep this operation independently deliverable after measure; command-help, frontier diagnostics, stop-state, metadata and the full analysis stack are not added prerequisites.

steps.title: Expose actual flags and correct conflicting usage
steps.verify: test -f cmd/overgodb-query/help_test.go && go test ./cmd/overgodb-query -run '^TestQueryHelpContract$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/help_contract_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestPlanHelpContract$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/finding/help_test.go && go test ./cmd/finding -run '^TestFindingHelpContract$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Fix the demonstrated existing commands first. overgodb-query discards FlagSet output and propagates ErrHelp as failure; plan -add advertises -verify while parsing -vcmd and reserving boolean -verify for execution. Render help from the same registered FlagSet used by execution through existing clioptions support. Explicit help prints purpose, actual flags/types/defaults and operation constraints, exits successfully and performs no store open, model load or mutation; invalid arguments still fail with usable guidance. Define purpose and intended audience once in the command owner, because a FlagSet cannot infer them. Remove copied usage signatures that disagree with registered flags. Acceptance exercises -h, -help, missing/unknown flags, -content discovery and -add/-vcmd versus boolean -verify. Test the printed command forms through the real parser. No generic CLI framework or migration of every binary before these fixes land.

Include cmd/finding, whose help currently discards the FlagSet output too. The dispatch contract must expose one parser-verified create/disposition invocation with required owner, evidence, closure and check inputs, using the same owner declarations. Naming a command without a discoverable invocation is insufficient; help inspection performs no finding writes.

steps.title: Show cheap admission diagnostics with the task before costly preparation
steps.verify: test -f internal/gate/dispatch_readiness_test.go && go test ./internal/gate -run '^TestCheapAdmissionReadiness$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/dispatch_readiness_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestPromptAdmissionReadiness$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Extract the existing cheap scope and readiness facts into their owning typed result, used by gate admission, preflight and plan prompt/context; do not copy refusal policy into cmd/plan or launch full preflight from prompt. Report branch/HEAD, changed and staged scope, unplanned dirty verification inputs, current stop, lease status, data-root resolution and specific missing input. When shipped paths are not yet declared, label scope provisional rather than invent a refusal. A plan-only publication has an exact docs/plan.json scope. Local cheap checks precede store replay, completion-authority resolution, candidate preparation, analysis and model loading; reuse the normal single store read for facts that need it. Prompt is a read-only snapshot: always show the task and distinguish blocked, advisory and unresolved facts; corrupt task/completion authority still refuses executable dispatch. At mutation admission recheck current state under the existing ownership. Acceptance reproduces dirty gate source refusal before expensive callbacks, provisional scope, absent data root, stale advisory lease, active stop, source/store change after prompt and an unaffected eligible task. Read-only diagnosis neither retires leases nor clears stops or moves concurrent files. One-command-publication consumes this result when available; it must not reimplement it or wait for a wider diagnostics campaign.

Include worker/session claimant and expected plan/claim revision once dispatch-claim is available. An advisory prompt never replaces atomic claim acquisition or grants editing authority over another worker's row.

steps.title: Keep valid frontier rows visible when advisory leases are stale
steps.rationale: Keep ready-task calculation authoritative and separate from advisory lease diagnostics. A stale or out-of-frontier lease must not hide every valid ready row; print the computed frontier plus typed warnings naming the affected worktree, task, claims and reason. Preserve real live ownership conflicts as blockers on affected admission; unreadable completion authority or store corruption is not downgraded to a warning. Print exact inspect/retire guidance only for the applicable lease class. Legacy retirement includes observed aliases/count and the existing reviewed compare-and-set command; this count is a preview, not permission or proof a changed set is safe. Modern stale leases need their own existing identity-bound retirement path, never the legacy blanket command by assumption. Acceptance includes stale unrelated lease, live conflict, malformed legacy lease, count/set change between preview and retirement, and valid unrelated rows. Reporting performs no retirement, lock stealing or mutation.

steps.title: Show a concise actionable contract and retain history by reference
steps.verify: test -f internal/plan/dispatch_contract_test.go && go test ./internal/plan -run '^TestDispatchContractBinding$' -count=1 && test -f cmd/plan/prompt_contract_test.go && go test ./cmd/plan -run '^TestPromptContractProjection$' -count=1
steps.rationale:
Extend the existing Step/AutomationContext schema with a bounded actionable contract and separate history/evidence references. Render the contract with the title, exact verifier, prerequisites, scope, frozen acceptance and stop conditions in prompt/context. Keep history available by explicit reference or history request, outside the normal task prompt. Do not heuristically truncate rationale and discard constraints. Migrate touched rows explicitly, preserving old schema readers or declaring a tested version transition, semantic merge and completion-authority binding. Contract changes invalidate dependent dispatch/acceptance; history-only edits do not authorize new work or erase obligations. Acceptance covers a constraint previously buried after a long rationale, legacy row migration, history omission from normal prompt, explicit history retrieval, contract tampering, and no duplicated operational state. Start with call-reach and publication rows; a whole-plan prose rewrite is not required.

Include claimant, execution mode, stop and readiness state plus a usable cmd/finding invocation from the shared command metadata. Do not hard-code a second usage signature in the prompt.

steps.title: Replace doctrine substring gates with semantic contract checks
steps.rationale:
The current campaign tests pin phrases including capability freeze enforced by structure, UNAVAILABLE and plan -setverify. Replace correctness assertions about prose with the owning typed policy/plan structure and behavior they were intended to protect. Reuse existing capability/admission/completion contracts; introduce the smallest typed declaration only for a real policy input not already represented. Do not copy all doctrine prose into JSON booleans or a parallel policy registry. Preserve independent negative tests: forbidden capability expansion, missing executable acceptance, unsupported outcome credited as success and invalid dependency/completion must still fail.

Acceptance changes wording without changing policy and passes; changes a protected semantic invariant while retaining every old phrase and fails. Update the affected validation and GUI campaign tests at their existing owner, retaining genuine lane/contract requirements. During migration any remaining literal pin is enumerated by source/test and surfaced by edit validation rather than discovered after expensive checks. A prettier string matcher is transitional, not completion. Policy/schema changes receive affected critical tests immediately; ordinary future prose edits must not trigger model suites.

steps.title: Reuse immutable analysis while rechecking current publication authority
steps.rationale:
First implement safe census reuse and cheaper publication through existing receipt, retry-cache, repository-analysis and admission owners. Cache immutable computations with all consumed inputs: relevant source content; analyzer/rule and toolchain identity; module/build-tag/platform selection; target Go version; baseline, exception and generated-policy inputs; applicable comparison source and selected paths. Separate census computation from admission that reads current policy, expiry or time. Preserve original result provenance under successor authorization. Do not add a second cache, scheduler, mode flag or alternate gate path.

Plan-authority memoization must bind the edited document digest, requested step, role and relevant policy as well as HEAD and store state. steps.title: Partition every selected package by its recorded selection cause
steps.rationale:
First-frontier read-only derivation from retained records; no dependency on census memoization or checkpoint-policy implementation. Retain all independently sufficient selection and receipt invalidation reasons. A deterministic primary cause supports the histogram only; removing it grants no exclusion while another reason remains. Do not force overlapping opaque-reader classifications into disjoint counts or equate selected packages with executed packages.

Partition every package the latest real gates selected, for the frozen change cases df95ba9c (evaluation code and plan), 3e6bf83a (test-only) and 5564cad1 (plan-only), by the cause the gate's selection explanation records: changed compiler input, transitive compiler dependency, named runtime read, opaque-reader taint, taint inherited through an importer, or a whole-tree environment input. Derive the partition from retained gate records and the existing package input graph classification; add no analysis. Each package receives exactly one primary cause with the path that produced it, and the counts must reproduce the recorded 230 executed packages and 191 opaque readers for the cases that recorded them. Publish the histogram through the existing gate cost and evidence owners with the exact record identities. Acceptance: TestSelectionCauseHistogram binds the partition to the recorded selected set, requires primary causes to sum to the selected count and execution outcomes to reconcile separately with actual started/completed/failed/unstarted records, rejects an unexplained package and rejects a package with two primary causes. This step decides between a structural dependency boundary, observed in-process read sets as the reuse trigger, and narrow call or effect analysis; it adopts nothing and grants no exclusion.

steps.title: Rank individual test cost inside the two costliest packages
steps.rationale:
First-frontier read-only derivation from retained records; no dependency on census memoization or checkpoint-policy implementation. Do not infer subprocess-versus-assertion cost from test names or aggregate elapsed time. Use retained child-execution spans when present; otherwise label that split unknown. Rank observed costs without requiring new broad-suite acquisition.

Rank the individual tests of internal/gate (811.757 s package lifecycle in the latest gate) and internal/audioparity (549.659 s) by measured elapsed time from the retained go test -json evidence, and separate subprocess fixture cost (git, nested go test, store open) from assertion cost. A package that every gate-policy change legitimately reruns is a suite-cost problem, not a selection problem; record which of the two each package is, because affected gate-policy regressions remain mandatory even when independent checks can be reused or excluded with proof. Acceptance: TestSuiteCostRanking binds the ranking to the retained record identities, requires start, end and outcome for every ranked test, reports summed test time separately from package wall, and rejects an unstarted or interrupted test counted as measured. No test is deleted or shortened here; the ranking names the first suite-cost candidate for the reduction contract.

Preserve the executable witness. This is a provenance defect; no failing test has been observed converted into a successful outcome. Keep the original execution result immutable and give successor reuse its own explicit authorization through the existing automationcheck cache/evidence and gate admission owners. Validate content identity and original/successor lineage at final admission; migrate checkpoint consumers and remove displaced restamping or partial validators. Retain exact environment, check definition, acceptance and input bindings. Old entries lacking required proof rerun once; failures, inapplicable checks and incomplete records grant no reuse. Test restart, chained reuse without recursive snapshot growth, identity/authority/input tampering, sibling failure and exact successful reuse with zero new execution. Preserve existing check selection and full gate-policy acceptance. Do not expand ordinary phase reuse here; recipe-node-reuse retains its format-selection, baseline and policy prerequisites.

steps.title: Freeze the real cost target, the chosen mechanism, the invalidators and the mutation matrix
steps.rationale: Choose the lowest total-cost sufficient mechanism on the measured target. Prefer removing an actual duplicated dependency/owner when that both avoids expensive work and shrinks API or binary surface; use narrow analysis only when the simpler boundary cannot preserve the frozen contracts. Do not implement all alternatives merely to compare them. Freeze the first reduction contract from the histogram and the ranking before any implementation: one expensive real target group; the mechanism chosen by comparing, on that same target, a structural dependency boundary change, observed in-process read sets as the reuse trigger, and narrow call or effect analysis, with the recorded expected saving and cost of each alternative; every legitimate compiler, runtime, environment and protocol invalidator; the expected selected and reused checks for the frozen change cases; the independent seeded mutation matrix; success criteria; the total-cost budget; and rollback. The matrix must include source, test, fixture, initialization and build-tag edits and also type, constant and variable edits, because the function-only code manifest cannot seed those. Observed reads are supporting evidence, not a complete dependency proof. Go test logging covers instrumented operations during its active lifetime; initialization, direct syscalls, native code, inherited handles, escaped callbacks, subprocess, network and clock effects can escape it. Bind observation coverage, relevant execution profile and static effect assumptions. Use observed inputs for reuse only when all relevant unobserved effects are independently bounded; otherwise preserve conservative obligations. Add initialization-before-logger, direct/native I/O and incomplete-trace counterexamples alongside relevant and unrelated input mutations. Never infer completeness from an absent log entry. Acceptance: TestTestingReductionContract binds the frozen contract to the histogram and ranking identities and rejects a contract that lacks the mutation matrix, the invalidator list or the recorded comparison of alternatives. Removing one uncertain runtime edge is not a saved execution while another legitimate invalidator remains.

steps.title: Make focused checkpoint publication stop forcing the whole integration suite
steps.rationale:
Sequence after accepted publication savings: those savings reduce the cost of this repair and later checkpoints. Keep the control change bounded to existing owners and the declared first-reduction batch. Bootstrap checkpoint publication under the existing gate acceptance once; this declaration alone changes no executable policy. Thereafter checkpoint commits remain unpromoted and retain cumulative obligations, so implementation subdivisions do not each require a full integration run. Prove the actual commit path, not only in-memory checkpoint selection. Reuse exact completed obligations for later audit rows; audit identity changes must not reacquire the model or repeat the broad integration suite. Current scope/admission and required affected critical checks remain mandatory.

Every later attempt in this row pays this cost, so it lands first. Repair, in the existing gate, plan and evidence owners, the behavior that makes a focused checkpoint publication run the whole integration suite; do not introduce a bypass flag, a second scheduler or separate infrastructure. A checkpoint stays implemented and unpromoted with explicit outstanding obligations; preserve failed attempts and exact successful receipts, and keep the original provenance of every reused result as source-evidence-binding establishes it. Acceptance: TestGateRepairBatchAcceptance exercises relevant and unrelated failures, sibling pass reuse, source changes, restart and cancellation, and proves that a focused checkpoint executes only its own obligations while the outstanding integration checks remain recorded and unpromoted.

steps.title: Implement the contract's chosen first reduction on the frozen target
steps.rationale:
Contract: implement only the lowest total-cost mechanism selected by reduction-contract, on its frozen real expensive consumer. Consume the completed repair-iteration prerequisite. Keep the candidate in shadow through the pre-existing integration scope; measured-adoption owns the sole retained-evidence payback review and promotion decision. Prefer a supported dependency/owner removal over broader analysis when it preserves the same contracts. No new scheduler, cache, policy bypass or unrelated model acquisition.

Acceptance: preserve the parent and distinct checkpoint verifies. Relevant source/test/fixture, init/build-tag, type/constant/variable, callee, environment/toolchain and protocol mutations must select the failing consumer and invalidate its receipt. Unrelated mutations must actually avoid the frozen expensive work. Separate compiler obligations from behavioral execution; removing one cause grants no exclusion while another remains. Bind original result provenance and all relevant inputs. Unknown reachable effects retain conservative coverage; missing, skipped, failed or incomplete results earn no pass. Observed reads require explicit instrumentation coverage and bounded unobserved effects.

Implementation constraints: one existing dependency result drives selection and receipt invalidation. Resolve only needed typed direct/generic/receiver/interface calls, initialization and helper flow; preserve alias, reassignment, escaped-function, callback, conditional/loop, shadowing, command argv/cwd and native-input counterexamples. Unreachable sibling readers must not taint a proven pure consumer. Positive isolation on a synthetic fixture alone is insufficient. Before broad adoption demonstrate the selected real exclusion with zero missed seeded failures and no stale successful receipts. Retain current full gate-policy acceptance; stop expanding analysis when the frozen target is met or the measured hypothesis is refused.

Batch: runtime regression and isolation checkpoints are subordinate obligations; TestFirstReductionAcceptance owns the final implementation assertion. The prerequisite contract is not repeated as a checkpoint. Focused checkpoint commits remain unpromoted with durable outstanding integration checks. Preserve independently valid receipts through retry, restart and cancellation; recheck current admission. Perform one broad implementation integration run, recording actual selected/executed/reused/failed/unstarted work and all preparation, wait, execution and finalization cost. measured-adoption consumes those records once.

steps.title: Review retained integration evidence and decide first-reduction adoption
steps.rationale:
Sole owner of the payback acceptance and promotion decision. This row absorbs the still-open measured-promotion obligation; consolidation grants no completion or evidence credit. call-reach owns implementation and its one pre-existing broad integration run. Evaluate its retained baseline/candidate records through this row's verifier once: actual expensive work avoided, seeded relevant failures detected, original receipt inputs and provenance, complete outcomes and total measured cost. No second audit row, broad-suite replay or model acquisition for unchanged records. Missing or stale evidence becomes the specific outstanding acquisition or affected repair, never an invented pass. Use the existing evidence and admission owners; the independent acceptance criteria remain fixed.

The first adoption decision covers the bounded implementation slice produced by call-reach, without requiring every historical opportunity below. One existing dependency owner supplies compilation inputs, required behavioral checks and receipt invalidation; remove the displaced competing rule when migrating consumers. Bind analysis results to relevant source/build/toolchain/environment identities. Freeze a representative mutation set before candidate selection; retain expected outcomes and the existing evaluator independently. Require zero missed seeded regressions and zero stale successful receipts in that declared set, with useful net elapsed savings including analysis, preparation, failed attempts and finalization. Exercise unrelated source/test changes, relevant fixture/callee changes, init/build-tag effects and unresolved calls. Reuse successful independent checks after sibling failure and restart; skipped or unfinished checks receive no credit. Keep required recompilation when behavioral retesting is excluded. A changed required contract reopens only its affected obligations. Gate-policy changes are accepted under the pre-existing scope. Compare the actual expensive group before and after; package-count reduction without saved work is insufficient. Preserve broad fallback with a reason only for unresolved reachable effects. A refused candidate leaves the current selector active and records the next specific obligation. After the first useful adoption, return to the next model bundle before expanding analysis or browser selection.

Retained acceptance requirements and incident evidence:

Compare cold and resumed attempts over the same docs/plan-only, browser, unit-test, runtime fixture, model-execution, kernel and gate-policy change matrix. Inject regressions and refuse any selection that misses a failure detected by the retained required scope. Measure wall to commit, preparation/queue/check/finalization time, executed/reused packages, model loads, outstanding checks and interventions. The 91537691 gate took 1270.6 seconds and executed 234 packages with zero reuse. Hatchet merge fd3a3250 took 1080.7 seconds with 7 reused and 226 executed packages; 154 opaque readers retained broad scope. The preceding browser failure took 925.1 seconds with 233 executed and zero reused packages. Use these concrete incidents, not a universal throughput floor. Publish through existing gate cost/evidence owners. Include merge snapshot preparation: this intake copies a source store with 117099 blobs; measure copying, syncing and replay before choosing immutable snapshot reuse or incremental backup. Preserve verified store ancestry and crash integrity. No recurring full benchmark merely to validate gate savings. Adoption may proceed independently of the modality report; broader batching still retains its recovery and promotion prerequisites. Prioritize ordinary documentation and plan edits: target seconds-scale publication and measure the ratio against the 1006.894-second documentation incident; 100x is an operator optimization target, not permission to omit required checks or a claimed result. Separate prose/assets from embedded inputs, fixtures, generated contracts and executable policy. Remove the recurring requirement to edit Go task-ID lists for routine plan additions while retaining substantive campaign constraints. Resolve non-Go consumer ownership before narrowing lanes; file extensions alone cannot authorize exclusion. Include preparation and finalization in the comparison. Make browser acceptance granular through the existing webui-lane -run selector: bind each journey to its component/route, shared shell, JavaScript/CSS dependencies and consumed HTTP contracts. Shared authentication, session and protocol changes widen to their consumers; unresolved reach retains the complete lane. Reuse independent scenario receipts across sibling failure and restart. Bind each selector to its owning package and refuse missing, skipped or zero-match targets. Prepare browser/server/model/GPU resources only for selected journeys that consume them. No second UI scheduler, policy list or receipt authority. Compare selected and full runs with seeded component, navigation and authentication regressions before adoption. Eliminate routine report-Markdown regeneration as a source of unrelated gate invalidation: consume existing typed report identities, distinguish a requested rendered view from authoritative state, and demonstrate unchanged evidence remains reusable. Preserve frozen long-form corpus identities when documentation changes; do not silently change an accepted corpus. Treat scheduling overlap separately from reduced test scope: record actual total cost and unchanged check coverage, and do not credit the browser/package overlap as solved opaque-input selection or package-evidence reuse.

Landed documentation measurement: 7367a3f8 completed the README and plan publication gate in 87.434 seconds, versus 153.329 seconds for 7589ed77. Runtime package, GPU and browser executions were all zero; modern-Go 17.901 seconds, bound acceptance 7.623 seconds, document checks 6.577 seconds and finalization 12.213 seconds. No competing analysis probes were run by this session during the measurement. This improves elapsed cost but does not meet the seconds-scale target. Gate-policy adoption 857fef83 took 1410.360 seconds after the browser contention repair, with 230 package executions and zero reuse; address the measured source-scope invalidation and static-analysis cost before claiming broad development-speed improvement. Preserve MiniCPM captures across these automation-only changes.

Current master measurement 959b9d6f: the accepted census/browser change still selected 158 direct and 72 dependent packages, with 191 opaque readers, 230 executed packages and zero reused receipts. Two preceding attempts exposed actual browser regressions; use those concrete counterexamples in the selection replay. A fast selector must retain the manifest-refresh, navigation and fixture-isolation failures while avoiding unrelated model acquisition. Include audio intake changes to resident sampling, decoder cleanup, shared MLP backward and optimizer progress as distinct mutation cases. Compare closure preparation and metadata generation cost as well as test duration; retained evidence and immutable source snapshots should be reused through existing owners.

Confirmed retry-policy gap: internal/gate.phaseReusesEvidence excludes the whole device and webui lanes. The audio merge's unchanged-source retry therefore repeats those lanes even though independent correctness checks passed. Separate reusable correctness receipts from timing/isolation-dependent measurements in the existing gate, device/browser runners and test-evidence owners. A reusable receipt must bind actual compiled dependencies, artifact/fixture identities, protocol/tolerances, toolchain, backend/driver/device identity and resolved environment; source equality alone is insufficient. Missing/changed inputs, skips, failed outcomes and unresolved ownership grant no credit. Preserve successful independent packages from a failed group without manufacturing a combined pass. Validate against this exact missing-corpus incident and deliberate fixture/backend/source mutations, then measure saved wall time and acquisitions before adoption. Do not simply add device/webui to a blanket phase whitelist or create a second cache/framework.

Master merge 25835603 is complete with parents 959b9d6f and 99cdcd8d; the committed plan is identical to the first parent. Accepted gate: 1908.1 seconds wall time, device 18m5.836s, dependent-package stage 8m43.506s, browser 1m45.381s, 230 executed packages and no reused receipts. The two failed gates plus the accepted gate total 3857.4 seconds, before merge preparation and focused repair checks. Keep these full-attempt costs in the payback comparison. The device correctness group passed before a separate measurement group; distinguish their contracts and reuse eligibility. Short-lane skips grant no dependent-fixture credit and do not replace required device acceptance. A post-merge source audit finds 155 directly opaque roots; the gate's 191-reader count includes its wider selected graph. Do not conflate those denominators.

The first attribution gate spent 905.8 seconds before Go stopped the owner package at its default aggregate 600-second timeout. Static and bound acceptance passed; device-wide and browser phases had not begun. The active batch-declaration test passed alone in 23.609 seconds. Concurrent lane merges were running during the failed attempt; preserve that resource context without asserting it explains every elapsed second. Remove avoidable serialization of isolated fixtures, retain completed checks, and distinguish aggregate suite exhaustion from an individual assertion failure or stalled test. Any later deadline-control change must preserve operator ceilings, cancellation and stuck-work detection through existing test-evidence/process owners; do not merely raise a fixed timeout or install another supervisor. Attribution must be captured before candidate teardown clears the input graph. Test the complete handoff with frozen input identity and parseable output, not just the formatter in isolation.

Rank savings only from actual execution evidence: package/check start, completed/failed/interrupted outcome and measured elapsed time. Use existing Go JSON and run-record owners; preserve unstarted planned work as unstarted, never assign it the duration of its phase. Keep summed parallel package duration separate from wall time. The current longest-phase attribution is scope context only. Bind each proposed exclusion to its full changed-input-to-check path and demonstrate that no compiler, environment, protocol or other runtime invalidator independently requires re-execution. Compare structural helper-boundary simplification with narrow analysis on the same expensive consumer and acceptance mutations before choosing further analysis investment.

Include checkable applicability and reuse certificates in the existing machine-readable report/evidence owners. Demonstrate a relevant mutation invalidates the certificate and selects its failing consumer, an unrelated mutation preserves the receipt, and an unresolved reachable effect retains required coverage. Record analysis and certificate-validation cost against actual saved execution; a diagram or missing graph path alone grants no evidence credit.

Automatic composition extends automationcheck.ManifestPlan, the existing dependency resolver and receipt owners. Derive required checks and their prerequisites from the cumulative candidate changes; keep compiler obligations separate from behavioral execution. Emit a machine-readable reason path for each selected check, matching reusable receipt or specific invalidator, and scoped unresolved boundary. Compose cheap refusal barriers before expensive work and independent checks under existing resource admission. No model-generated exemption or second scheduler. Measure each additional rule against the already accepted selector as well as the retained original matrix; preserve exact receipts for unchanged checks across additions. Adoption remains under the pre-existing gate and frozen counterexamples.

Verification recipes: orchestrate gates with the same compile, bind, admit, execute and record discipline as model recipes. Compile a deterministic, content-addressed DAG from the cumulative source change and resolved impact through automationcheck.Plan/ManifestPlan; bind each invocation to its check definition, actual inputs, environment, dependencies, resources and unchanged acceptance. Reuse the existing recipe artifact kind, execution authority, DAG runner, gate and run-record owners rather than adding a parallel recipe framework. Persist the composed recipe before execution and resume outstanding nodes after interruption. A newly composed whole-plan identity does not by itself invalidate a completed node whose relevant definition, inputs and acceptance still match; preserve its original provenance and bind reuse explicitly into the new recipe. Changes after freezing create a successor recipe and reopen only affected obligations. Keep unresolved input boundaries explicit, preparation demand-driven, cheap checks ahead of expensive checks and resource release attached to node lifetime. Acceptance covers deterministic composition, dependency closure, recipe tampering, relevant and unrelated mutations, cross-recipe exact reuse, sibling failure, restart and cancellation; retain existing full policy acceptance before adoption. Dynamic composition selects and binds approved checks; it cannot generate weaker assertions or new acceptance thresholds.

Static-analysis granularity: distinguish phase selection from analysis scope. Current formatting uses changed Go files, while vet invokes ./... and the modern-Go census inspects the broader source snapshot. Measure executed analysis work before choosing the first reduction. Reuse immutable per-file syntax results where rules are file-local; type/call checks include the affected package and proven dependent closure; repository aggregates retain their complete invariant using exact unchanged contributions. Bind analyzer/rule version, file/package inputs, compiler/build tags, environment and policy data. Cover edits, additions, removals, renames, import/API changes, generated inputs, policy changes and restart with seeded failures against the full analyzer. Unknown effects retain broad scope. Report analyzed/reused units and actual wall/compute cost; a changed-file trigger does not prove changed-file-only execution. Adopt one useful real reduction before extending analysis; retain the existing full gate until its acceptance passes. Touched-file literal review follows owning contracts and independent fixtures; it does not justify a second global scan.

Measured test-only case: commit 3e6bf83a changed cmd/diffusion/main_test.go plus the plan and gate-owned census outputs, yet executed 230 packages with zero reuse; scope reported 191 opaque runtime readers. Use its retained gate execution records as a concrete over-selection witness. Separate changed test inputs, generated census inputs and unresolved production reads when explaining each selection. Demonstrate one legitimate exclusion with seeded relevant failures before broad adoption; changing only the trigger or suppressing an unknown reader is not proof.

steps.title: Remove one duplicated automation API or executable with its callers
steps.rationale:
Next compounding priority after the first adopted reduction, ahead of broader value-flow analysis and general recipe reuse. If the first reduction already removes this owner, consume its exact migration and removal evidence instead of implementing or acquiring it again. A necessary small consolidation inside publication or reduction work belongs in that batch; do not wait for this row to remove a touched duplicate. Prioritize one real API/binary consolidation alongside the publication and gate work when the touched ownership boundary makes it cheap; do not turn a whole-repository inventory into a prerequisite. Reuse the API manifest, command/build inventory and measured caller graph. Freeze the duplicated responsibility, existing canonical owner, all Go exports, command entrypoints, scripts/CI/plan/release callers and external compatibility obligations. Choose an eligible duplicate before dispatch; if removal requires unresolved consumers or increases coupling, choose another bounded target. Prefer deleting a redundant command package or exported wrapper and its independent policy path over adding a forwarding facade.

Acceptance must show the removed old implementation/export or executable is absent from source and the intended build/release inventory, all known consumers use the canonical operation, and equivalent success/refusal/cancellation/exit/evidence behavior. Retire stale distributed binaries through the owning packaging manifest; do not delete arbitrary operator files. Use typed operations only where the responsibility is shared; keep distinct process isolation, privilege and lifecycle contracts explicit. Record before/after exported symbols, forwarding wrappers, command packages, shipped executables, duplicated decisions, transitive build/test dependencies, compile/link time and aggregate artifact bytes. Counts are separate denominators, not a substitute for behavior or a mandate for one giant binary. Reject increased dependency fan-out or verification cost without measured compensating benefit. Preserve original protocol/flag compatibility where externally required; any temporary alias has one owner, a specific consumer migration obligation and a removal trigger. No permanent wrapper pile.

TestCommonOwnerConsolidationAcceptance must bind real caller migration, removed surface and preserved contracts; extend the existing apimanifest owner for the source/build inventory assertions instead of creating another census or public API. Internal automation cleanup can proceed without the full modality campaign; changes to numerical behavior or external public contracts retain their specific existing prerequisites. Feed this exact inventory to simplify-command-surface rather than repeating it.

Use the resolved caller evidence for the chosen boundary to consolidate one measured gate responsibility, starting with selection and evidence-input ownership. Inventory actual entrypoints, transformations, side effects and duplicate decisions; similarity alone is not equivalence. Freeze the callers and success/refusal/cancellation/restart/persistence contracts before editing. Select the existing implementation that owns the responsibility, migrate every affected caller and delete the other implementation and forwarding-only wrappers in the same verification batch. Preserve intentional distinctions as typed inputs only when existing consumers require them. No generic utility merger, new facade over old paths, parallel cache, scheduler or policy registry. Prove preserved result identities and obligations, unchanged relevant failure detection and fewer independently maintained decisions; report removed exports/wrappers/branches and net code surface without arbitrary count targets. Include a counterexample for each intentional difference so consolidation cannot silently flatten semantics. Bind new owner-specific acceptance when the concrete responsibility is selected; retain the listed gate tests as lower bounds. Reject or re-scope a candidate that adds coupling, acquisition or total verification cost without compensating benefit. This early pilot is confined to automation; model execution, numerical APIs, HTTP and broad public command consolidation retain their existing regression/lane prerequisites. Pass the resulting caller map and removed-owner list to simplify-command-surface/do instead of repeating the census.

Generate focused sequence views on demand from the same graph records and execution provenance; do not maintain separate diagram facts or automatically write Markdown reports. Render Mermaid through the existing report surface, distinguishing static possible paths, observed execution and unresolved relationships. Show calls, reads, callbacks and resource acquire/release ordering only where the graph establishes that ordering; do not invent a total order for concurrent operations. Use the backup metadata-capture/blob-copy lock boundary as a concrete resource-lifetime example if it remains useful. Acceptance must bind view edges to their source records, preserve unknown branches and distinguish observations from completeness claims. Use these views to select an actual duplicated owner or oversized lock scope, not as a prerequisite for independent model validation.

This local ownership repair need not wait for general selector adoption. Choose a boundary whose actual callers and contracts can already be enumerated; unresolved relevant callers require their existing coverage. Preserve the full gate and grant no new exclusion here. Compare dependency simplification with further call/value analysis on the same expensive consumer before choosing either; reuse that comparison in measured-adoption. Generated sequence views are supporting evidence, not a new scheduling authority.

steps.title: Reuse unchanged verification nodes across composed recipes
steps.rationale:
Follow the first expensive-work reduction unless this specific cache defect demonstrably blocks its frozen target. The in-progress source-evidence-binding repair remains separate and keeps its current verifier and identity. Existing lane/report checks remain lower bounds. Aggregate existing per-model evidence and acquire only missing or invalidated cells; do not rebuild an evaluation engine or launch long benchmarks from this assertion.

Controller-effectiveness deliverable, after model validation: use existing experiment/evaluation owners for one bounded comparison of an existing planning or repair policy, a frozen baseline and an ablation. Freeze task IDs, held-out split, case denominator, policy identities, acceptance judge, repeats, equal end-to-end budgets and decision thresholds before candidate runs. Include verification cost and interrupted/failed attempts. Publish accepted improvements, regressions, operator interventions, total wall/compute cost and uncertainty from repeat outcomes; distinguish changes to inference capability from changes to controller efficiency. Gate shadow-selection tests alone do not satisfy this experiment. Accept a measured improvement only under the frozen rule and independent unchanged judge; accept a complete negative/inconclusive experiment as a no-promotion decision so the graph does not demand a positive result. Missing cases remain incomplete. Extend the existing report owner, not another RSI framework.

Bind TestAcceptedControllerComparison in cmd/benchmark-report/controller_comparison_test.go as a read-only evidence assertion. It must reject omitted/duplicate tasks, unequal budgets, changed judges, held-out leakage, uncounted failures and unsupported improvement claims, while accepting a complete evidence-bound refusal. The same report also compares E4B with the subsequent model validation workflow using workload/coverage denominators, operator interventions, model loads and repeated gate work; report actual differences without attributing different model workloads to scheduler gains.
